verdict.rationale: n8n documents running its own instance locally or self-hosted via Docker Compose or a one-line installer. It also offers source control and environments with push and pull of changes, and recommends a separate test instance, which together support local and dev-instance development. However, nothing in the pack shows how workflows are executed headlessly or wired into CI test pipelines; the CLI page is only a title with no described run or execute commands. Missing for 10: documented CLI or API workflow execution for CI, CI testing guidance or integration, details of the dev-to-prod environment workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of local dev/CI use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run workflows locally or against a dev instance for development and CI testing

citations.quote: You can self-host n8n on your own infrastructure, on-premises, or in a private cloud, using Docker Compose, one-line setup, or other deployment methods.
the vendor's guidance for safety is a separate test workflow or test instance
